A regular octagon has 8 sides. The formula for the measure of each interior angle of a regular polygon with n sides is:

\[
\text{Interior angle} = \frac{(n-2) \times 180^\circ}{n}
\]

For an octagon, \( n = 8 \):

\[
\text{Interior angle} = \frac{(8-2) \times 180^\circ}{8} = \frac{6 \times 180^\circ}{8} = \frac{1080^\circ}{8} = 135^\circ
\]

Answer: B
